### Meaning
| infl.      | class        | meaning       |
| ---------- | ------------ | ------------- |
| ~          | *n.*         | grain, cereal |
### Etymology
#### Glyph
禾, but instead of a hanging grain I added four lines detached from the stem, showing either grains or ears e.g. of corn, wheat, etc.
#### Sound
- french "pain"
- toki pona "pan".
- *a priori:* p=freshness, an=natural
